newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps - Steady in directionless talk.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps - Steady in directionless talk.

text.p: Singapore oil product swaps were steady in quiet directionless talk as the market awaited physical players to return following the long Lunar New Year and Eid-el-Fitri holidays, brokers said.
"The market is very quiet. Most people are still on the sidelines waiting for some direction from the physical players," one broker said.
March gas oil swaps were last quoted largely unchanged from Tuesday at $25.30/$25.50 per barrel with no trades confirmed, they said.
Traders said the market may pick up later today on firmer overnight gas oil closing on London's International Petroleum Exchange, where February futures ended up $4.50 per tonne at $192.50.
Traders said continued buying interest in the physical market in the face of aggressive offers by a local trader has led to some optimism.
On Tuesday, the trader sold a 150,000-barrel cargo at $25.10 per barrel free-on-board Singapore, 20 cents below Thursday's traded level.
Jet fuel prices are steady at with the March jet fuel/gas oil spread last quoted unchanged at $2.50/$2.90 per barrel, brokers said. The market traded last night at $2.60 per barrel, one broker said.
Fuel oil swaps were also unchanged in thin trading with March seen at $100.50/$102.25 per tonne.
